tailoring.headline: Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud – Senior Java & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs and headless commerce. Proven track record designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Strong techno-functional consulting experience, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs for international stakeholders. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Pfeiffer Vacuum’s commitment to innovative vacuum solutions and its digital expansion. The Inhouse Consultant role aligns perfectly with my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, where I delivered complex e-commerce integrations and headless commerce APIs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation and Shell I designed and implemented core SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) features, covering product catalog, pricing and order management, using Java, Spring and Spring Boot.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: I built and optimized OCC REST web services and PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders), and led API migrations that improved system stability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I gathered requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications, and coordinated with international business and IT stakeholders.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), leveraging Docker, Kubernetes and Jenkins for reliable releases and production support.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026, earliest start 16.12.2026, available for interview

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Kombination aus führender Vakuumtechnologie und digitaler Transformation bei Pfeiffer Vacuum begeistert mich. Die Position des Inhouse Consultants passt ideal zu meinen über 5 Jahren Erfahrung mit SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell, wo ich komplexe E-Commerce-Integrationen und Headless-APIs realisiert habe.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich Kernfunktionen der SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) entwickelt, einschließlich Produktkatalog, Preisgestaltung und Auftragsmanagement, mit Java, Spring und Spring Boot.

bullets.label: API- und Integrations-Expertise
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Webservices und PIM-ERP-MDM-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) aufgebaut und optimiert sowie API-Migrationen geleitet, die die Systemstabilität verbesserten.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: In einer techno-funktionalen Rolle habe ich Anforderungen erfasst, User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen erstellt und mit internationalen Fach- und IT-Stakeholdern koordiniert.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Ich habe CI/CD-Deployments im SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) durchgeführt und Docker, Kubernetes sowie Jenkins für zuverlässige Releases und Produktionssupport eingesetzt.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026, ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: Pfeiffer Vacuum is a global leader in high-performance vacuum technology, continuously expanding its digital footprint. I admire the company’s focus on innovation and sustainability, and see a clear need for robust e-commerce platforms to serve its worldwide customer base. My deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and proven integration record can help accelerate Pfeiffer’s digital commerce strategy, improve customer experiences, and support its growth objectives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about driving digital commerce excellence, I bring deep SAP Commerce expertise and proven integration success to support Pfeiffer Vacuum’s growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’d love to discuss how I can help Pfeiffer Vacuum accelerate its e-commerce initiatives.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud position. I have over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, with strong expertise in integration, API development and techno-functional consulting. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
